instructions: Drain the olives, cornichons, pearl onions, peppers and anchovies and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Wrap one anchovy fillet around an olive. Push a skewer through the middle of the olive so it holds both sides of the anchovy.
Thread on a pickled pepper, folded or cut in half, then a pearl onion, and finish with a cornichon.
Make 8 skewers the same way and arrange them on a platter. Drizzle the olive oil over them. Serve at room temperature.
method_notes: Neither page has ratings. The lead is Food Republic, which gives no amounts, so the count of 8 skewers (one anchovy each) comes from Inspired Cuisine and the usual one or two per person. Both agree on the build: an olive, an anchovy and pickles on a pick, drizzled with olive oil. The hot Spanish green chili is swapped for a mild pickled pepper to keep the base mild.
